subject: Startups
title: Why VCs Say No
description: Learn Why VCs Say No in one minute.

hook.text: VCs reject 99% of pitches. Understanding why helps founders avoid the most common deal-killers.

buildup.text: Top reasons: market too small, team too weak, no traction, bad timing, or the VC already backed a competitor.

discovery.text: The sneaky reason: 'not my thesis.' Every VC has sectors they focus on. Even a great startup might not fit.

twist.text: Many VCs won't tell you the real reason. They say 'not right now' when they mean 'not ever.'

climax.text: Rejection isn't always about quality. Fit, timing, and portfolio balance all matter more than founders realize.

punchline.text: A 'no' often means 'not for me,' not 'not good enough.'

quiz.question: What is a common hidden reason VCs pass on startups?
options: It doesn't match their investment thesis
